evals.prompt: Refine this prompt: "Turn this meeting transcript into Jira tickets." We push the result into Jira through the REST API.
evals.expected_output: Eight-row decision table with reasons; RTF or RISEN base with Format added; JSON ticket schema; transcript as input variable first; constraint against invented assignees/dates; questions only for unfillable included components, recommended option first.
assertions: all-eight-components-decided: the decisions table has a row for each of role, context, audience, instructions, examples, constraints, format, input
every-decision-has-because: every row of the decisions table has a non-empty reason
composition-block-present: SELECT, KEEP/ADD and DROP lines are present, and SELECT names a framework with a reason
recommended-option-first: every question lists the recommended option first, labeled (Recommended)
no-question-for-excluded: no question is asked about a component the table leaves out
xml-tagged-prompt: the refined prompt wraps components in XML tags
jira-json-format: the format defines a JSON structure with named ticket fields
jira-no-invented-data: a constraint stops the model inventing assignees or due dates

evals.prompt: Refine this prompt: "You are a helpful assistant. Write a LinkedIn post about our new product launch. Make it engaging."
evals.expected_output: CO-STAR base; audience and tone included; vague 'engaging' replaced with concrete tone/style; generic role dropped or replaced; questions for product facts.
assertions: all-eight-components-decided: the decisions table has a row for each of the eight components
every-decision-has-because: every row of the decisions table has a non-empty reason
composition-block-present: SELECT, KEEP/ADD and DROP lines are present
recommended-option-first: every question lists the recommended option first, labeled (Recommended)
no-question-for-excluded: no question is asked about a component the table leaves out
xml-tagged-prompt: the refined prompt wraps components in XML tags
linkedin-vague-engaging-fixed: 'engaging' is replaced by a concrete tone, style or length instruction
